summary: Implemented TemplateService with full template discovery, validation, and parameter resolution. Created IDocumentTemplate types (src/types/template.types.ts), JSON Schema (templates/schema.json), template validator (src/templates/validator.ts), parameter substitution engine (src/templates/parameterizer.ts), and the central TemplateService class (src/services/template.service.ts) with caching via Map<string, IDocumentTemplate>. Exported singleton from src/services/index.ts. Added three sample templates covering all categories (invoice, pdf-conversion, contract-summarization). Build compiles cleanly, all 977 existing tests pass.
